import more_itertools as mi

# Test with very large positive offsets
print('Large positive:', list(mi.stagger([1,2,3], offsets=(100,), fillvalue='X')))

# Test with mixed positive and negative
print('Mixed:', list(mi.stagger([1,2,3], offsets=(-1, 1), fillvalue='X')))
print('Mixed longest:', list(mi.stagger([1,2,3], offsets=(-1, 1), fillvalue='X', longest=True)))

# Test with generator that raises exception
def bad_gen():
    yield 1
    raise ValueError('test error')
try:
    list(mi.stagger(bad_gen()))
except ValueError as e:
    print('Generator error:', e)
